reviews.title: More like Scammer app
reviews.text: I had been using this scanner app happily for a couple of years now. I’m a college student and I need to be able to scan handwritten work to submit as a pdf. Three months ago, I would have rated this app 5/5 stars, but the last few updates have made the free version of this app nearly unusable. The app no longer allows me to take a wider picture and crop out what I want.  The app attempts to hone in on writing but inadvertently crops out the entire margin and sometimes some of the writing. With the most recent update I have to watch two or three adds to save and edit my work. The app is constantly forcing me to watch adds and tries to make me pay for a subscription. I can’t work with this anymore.

reviews.title: Absolutely Irritating
reviews.text:
I have used this app in the past and had a really great experience. However, recently it has become overrun with ads. Every time I exit or enter any page, a 20 second video advertisement shows up that can’t be skipped. I am just left to bear it while practically ripping my hair out. Along with this, the crop feature does not work, and the buttons often get stuck. After a half an hour of trying to scan sheet music, I gave up when once again I was met with the same advertisement I had seen five times prior in the middle of fighting the crop buttons to actually do what they are supposed to. It’s safe to say this app has been deleted. For your own  sanity, do not 
download.
